perfil: Firefly, who controls transformable armament, is said to be a super weapon secretly developed by Grace Imperium. The firefly-like glow, when gathered in multitude, can become a cannon capable of extreme destruction.

habilidades.b: Throws electromagnetic darts at the target, dealing DMG.

tpl.s: Throws electromagnetic darts to attack the target. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto ATK DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto ATK DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto ATK DMG.

tpl.s: Firefly enters ⟨Artillery Form⟩ for 14s, during which, transforms all 4 ⟨Avalanche⟩ into Avalanche: Floating Cannons, which take turns firing at the target, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Skill DMG. Avalanche: Floating Cannons can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩ and generate ⟨Lucent⟩: deals ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Lux Mark DMG and inflicts 1 stack of ⟨Glimmer⟩.

habilidades.b: Firefly enters ⟨Sword Form⟩, transforming ⟨Avalanche⟩ into Avalanche: Giant Sword and Avalanche: Flying Blades to attack the target for a period of time. Avalanche: Giant Sword and Avalanche: Flying Blades can inflict ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩.

tpl.s: Firefly enters ⟨Sword Form⟩ for 16s , during which, transforms 2 ⟨Avalanche⟩ into Avalanche: Giant Sword and 2 ⟨Avalanche⟩ into Avalanche: Flying Blades. Firefly wields Avalanche: Giant Sword to attack the target. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto ATK DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto ATK DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto ATK DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto ATK DMG. While ⟨Sword Form⟩ is active, automatically fires all Avalanche: Flying Blades every 3s to attack the target, dealing ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Lux Skill DMG to targets along their path. Avalanche: Giant Sword and Avalanche: Flying Blades inflict ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩ when dealing DMG.

habilidades.b: Combines ⟨Avalanche⟩ into gigantic cannons and continuously fires at the target, then combines them into a giant sword to strike the target, dealing multiple instances of DMG.

tpl.s: Combines ⟨Avalanche⟩ into 2 gigantic cannons and fires forward 2 times. Each shot deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Ultimate DMG and then transforms into a giant sword to perform a forward slash, dealing ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Lux Ultimate DMG. All of Firefly's skill Cooldowns are reset when Stellar Torrent ends.

builds.d: A DPS build that concentrates Avalanche: Floating Cannons' energy and focuses on a single target.
A DPS build that spreads Avalanche: Floating Cannons' firepower and excels at attacking multiple targets.

l.b: Avalanche: Floating Cannons attack the target simultaneously, dealing DMG. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩.
l.s: Avalanche: Floating Cannons now attack the target simultaneously, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto ATK DMG every 0.5s. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩. Increasing Firefly's ATK SPD reduces the interval between attacks.

l.b: After Avalanche: Floating Cannons deal multiple instances of DMG to the same target, increases own Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: When Avalanche: Floating Cannons deal DMG to the same target, Firefly gains 1 stack of Focus. Switching target will remove 1 stack of Focus. When Focus stacks 12 times, enhances ⟨Artillery Form⟩'s Avalanche: Floating Cannons, increasing Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: While Firefly is in ⟨Artillery Form⟩, Avalanche: Floating Cannons periodically fire a volley at the target, dealing bonus DMG. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩.
l.s: While Firefly is in ⟨Artillery Form⟩, Avalanche: Floating Cannons fire a volley at the target every 6s, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG. Upon hitting the target, the volley triggers an explosion, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Lux Auto Attack DMG. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩.

l.b: When Avalanche: Floating Cannons deal DMG to the boss or elite targets, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: When Avalanche: Floating Cannons deal DMG to the boss or elite targets, increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 3s, stacking up to 100 times.

l.b: Increases Firefly's Auto Attack DMG dealt to lone targets.
l.s: When Firefly deals DMG to a lone target, increases Auto Attack DMG dealt by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When dealing DMG, Avalanche: Floating Cannons generate Scorching Sunray that continuously attacks the target's position. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩.
l.s: When dealing DMG, Avalanche: Floating Cannons generate Scorching Sunray that continuously attacks the target's position, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Skill DMG every 0.4s for 2s. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩. Scorching Sunray can only be triggered once on each target every 10s. Up to 4 Scorching Sunray can exist at once.

l.b: The beams fired by Avalanche: Floating Cannons can refract, simultaneously dealing DMG to multiple targets. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩.
l.s: The beams fired by Avalanche: Floating Cannons can refract up to 4 times, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Skill DMG. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩. The same target cannot be hit by refracted beams more than once.

l.b: When casting the Main Skill, Firefly shoots an energy round, dealing AoE DMG. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩.
l.s: When casting Star Barrage (Main Skill), Firefly shoots an energy round, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Skill DMG, then causing an explosion to deal ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Lux Skill DMG. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩.

l.b: Increases Skill DMG dealt by Avalanche: Floating Cannons at set intervals.
l.s: Increases Skill DMG dealt by Avalanche: Floating Cannons' next attack by ⟦0⟧ every 4s. Each Avalanche: Floating Cannon has its own timer.

l.b: When Avalanche: Floating Cannons hit different targets afflicted with ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases the squad's ATK.
l.s: Whenever Avalanche: Floating Cannons hit a target afflicted with ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases the squad's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 7s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: Increases Firefly's Mark DMG. Every time Firefly triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases own Lux DMG.
l.s: Increases Firefly's Mark DMG by ⟦0⟧. Every time Firefly triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩, increases her Lux DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 6s, stacking up to 10 times.

l.b: Increases the number of times Firefly can dodge. After dodging, Firefly deals Lux DMG to nearby targets and stuns them. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩.
l.s: Firefly can dodge one more time. When Firefly dodges, she leaves behind a Shadow that deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Skill DMG to nearby targets and stuns them for 3s. This effect can only be triggered once every 7s. Can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩.

l.b: The Ultimate can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩. When the mark is triggered, increases own ATK.
l.s: Stellar Torrent (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Lux Mark⟩ and summon a ⟨Lucent⟩, dealing 17%/22%/27.1%/32.2%/37.2%/42.3% of ATK as Lux Mark DMG. When the mark is triggered, increases own ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 20s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: After Firefly casts the Ultimate, increases her Lux DMG the next time she casts a skill.
l.s: After Firefly casts Stellar Torrent (Ultimate), increases her Lux DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 30s the next time she casts a skill.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Firefly's Ultimate.
l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Stellar Torrent (Ultimate) by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Firefly's Ultimate to targets with low HP.
l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Stellar Torrent (Ultimate) to targets with HP below 80% by ⟦0⟧.

builds.d: A DPS build that enhances Avalanche: Flying Blade, specializing in striking a target with high-frequency attacks.
A DPS build that enhances Avalanche: Giant Sword, continuously striking the target with heavy blows.

l.b: In an all-Lux squad, casting the Support Skill grants additional Avalanche: Flying Blades. Whenever Avalanche: Flying Blade deals DMG, increases own Skill DMG and Skill Crit Rate.
l.s: In an all-Lux squad, casting Starflare Pursuit (Support Skill) grants additional Avalanche: Flying Blades and increases ATK frequency afterwards. Whenever Avalanche: Flying Blade deals DMG, increases Avalanche: Flying Blade's Skill Crit Rate by ⟦0⟧ and increases Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧ while this ⟨Sword Form⟩ is active, stacking up to 20 times.

l.b: Increases the Skill Crit Rate of Avalanche: Flying Blade when it deals DMG. Whenever Avalanche: Flying Blade deals DMG, it deals additional AoE DMG and inflicts ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩.
l.s: Increases the Skill Crit Rate of Avalanche: Flying Blade by ⟦0⟧ when it deals DMG. Whenever Avalanche: Flying Blade deals DMG, it deals an additional ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Lux Skill DMG and inflicts ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩.

l.b: After the Lux Main Trekker triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩ and generates ⟨Lucent⟩, increases the Skill Crit Rate and Skill DMG of Avalanche: Flying Blade the next time Firefly is in ⟨Sword Form⟩.
l.s: When the Main Trekker triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩, Firefly gains 1 stack of Glow. When ⟨Lucent⟩ is generated afterwards, Firefly gains 1 stack of Halo. Both effects can stack up to 20 times. When casting Starflare Pursuit (Support Skill), Firefly consumes all stacks of Glow and Halo. For the current ⟨Sword Form⟩'s active duration, increases Avalanche: Flying Blade's Skill Crit Rate by ⟦0⟧ for each stack of Glow consumed; increases Avalanche: Flying Blade's Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧ for each stack of Halo consumed.

l.b: When the Lux Main Trekker deals Skill DMG, generates Avalanche: Flying Blade to strike the target, dealing additional DMG and inflicting ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩. When this Avalanche: Flying Blade deals DMG, it increases the target's Lux DMG Taken based on the number of ⟨Glimmer⟩ stacks on the target.
l.s: When the Lux Main Trekker deals Skill DMG, generates 1 Avalanche: Flying Blade to strike the target, dealing ⟦0⟧ of Firefly's ATK as Lux Skill DMG and inflicting ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩. When this Avalanche: Flying Blade deals DMG, it increases the target's Lux DMG Taken by ⟦1⟧ for 10s based on the number of ⟨Glimmer⟩ stacks on the target, stacking up to 20 times. This effect can only be triggered once every 3s, and Firefly does not need to be on the battlefield.

l.b: When ⟨Sword Form⟩ ends, Firefly commands all ⟨Avalanche⟩ to strike targets around her, dealing AoE DMG and inflicting ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩. Increases Firefly's Skill Crit DMG each time this effect deals DMG.
l.s: When ⟨Sword Form⟩ ends, Firefly commands all ⟨Avalanche⟩ to strike targets around her. Each ⟨Avalanche⟩ deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Lux Skill DMG and inflicts ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩. Increases Firefly's Skill Crit DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 15s each time this effect deals DMG, stacking up to 12 times.

l.b: In an all-Lux squad, increases the attack range and Auto Attack DMG of Avalanche: Giant Sword. Whenever Avalanche: Giant Sword attacks, it triggers an additional attack, dealing DMG and inflicting ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩.
l.s: In an all-Lux squad, extends the attack range of Avalanche: Giant Sword and increases its Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧. Whenever Avalanche: Giant Sword attacks, it triggers an additional attack, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto ATK DMG and inflicting ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩.

l.b: After Avalanche: Giant Sword attacks a certain number of times, Firefly automatically casts Dominating Slash, dealing DMG and inflicting ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩.
l.s: After Avalanche: Giant Sword attacks 8 times, Firefly automatically casts Dominating Slash, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK, ⟦1⟧ of ATK, and ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto ATK DMG and inflicting ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩.

l.b: When Avalanche: Giant Sword deals DMG, it deals additional AoE DMG and inflicts ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩.
l.s: When Avalanche: Giant Sword deals DMG, it deals an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Auto ATK DMG and inflicts ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩. This effect can only be triggered once every 1s.

l.b: While Firefly is in ⟨Sword Form⟩, increases the Auto Attack DMG dealt by Avalanche: Giant Sword over time. Increases Firefly's Movement SPD when she is too far from her target or has no target.
l.s: While Firefly is in ⟨Sword Form⟩, increases the Auto Attack DMG dealt by Avalanche: Giant Sword by ⟦0⟧, stacking up to 15 times. Increases Firefly's Movement SPD by 100% when she is too far from her target or has no target.

l.b: When the Main Trekker triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩ and generates ⟨Thunderbolt⟩ while Firefly is on the battlefield, increases her own ATK and the Lux DMG Taken of nearby targets.
l.s: When the Main Trekker triggers ⟨Lux Mark⟩ and generates ⟨Thunderbolt⟩ while Firefly is on the battlefield, increases the Lux DMG Taken of targets near her by ⟦0⟧, and increases Firefly's ATK by ⟦1⟧ for 4s, stacking up to 10 times.

l.b: Increases the squad's Lux DMG in an all-Lux squad. When Firefly is on the battlefield, additionally increases the squad's Lux DMG.
l.s: Increases the squad's Lux DMG by ⟦0⟧ in an all-Lux squad. When Firefly is on the battlefield, increases the squad's Lux DMG by an additional ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Firefly's Ultimate can inflict ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩. When Firefly casts the Ultimate, the Lux Main Trekker gains a shield.
l.s: Stellar Torrent (Ultimate) can inflict ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩. When Firefly casts the Ultimate, the Lux Main Trekker gains a shield equal to ⟦0⟧ of Firefly's Base Max HP for 5s.

l.b: When Firefly casts the Support Skill, increases the ATK of Lux Trekkers in the squad.
l.s: When Firefly casts Starflare Pursuit (Support Skill), increases the ATK of Lux Trekkers in the squad by ⟦0⟧ for 26s.

l.b: After Firefly casts the Ultimate, increases her Lux DMG the next time she casts a skill.
l.s: After Firefly casts Stellar Torrent (Ultimate), increases her Lux DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 30s the next time she casts a skill.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Firefly's Ultimate.
l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Stellar Torrent (Ultimate) by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Firefly's Ultimate to targets with low HP.
l.s: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Stellar Torrent (Ultimate) to targets with HP below 80% by ⟦0⟧.
